itens.titulo: Apple and Alphabet Are Especially Scared of a Blue Wave
itens.descricao: Apple and Alphabet Are Especially Scared of a Blue Wave Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - AAPL trades at 45x earnings after a 26% gain, leaving little cushion if Services is hit, while GOOGL trades at just 16x earnings with more room to absorb antitrust pressure.
- A Democratic Senate, priced at 65% odds, could pass app-store legislation targeting Apple's 75.6% margin Services business and break up Google's $63B Search engine.
Apple's growth came from a 22% jump in iPhone sales.
Polymarket prices Democratic control of the House at 0.905, so the political risk behind those results is worth a close look.
iPhone Upgrades Carry Apple as AI Demand Carries Google Cloud Apple's fiscal Q3 revenue reached $109.42B, up 16.4%.
EPS of $2.02 beat the $1.89 consensus, which shows how strong the iPhone 17 cycle has been.
Tim Cook said demand exceeded Apple's own plans: "It's a demand forecast issue, to be candid." Apple expects supply constraints to get worse this quarter, and memory costs are still rising.

itens.titulo: Ahead of Meta Platforms (META) Q3 Earnings: Get Ready With Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
itens.descricao: Ahead of Meta Platforms (META) Q3 Earnings: Get Ready With Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics Yahoo Finance
trechos: In its upcoming report, Meta Platforms (META) is predicted by Wall Street analysts to post quarterly earnings of $6.67 per share, reflecting a decline of 8% compared to the same period last year.
Revenues are forecasted to be $63.18 billion, representing a year-over-year increase of 23.3%.
The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has been revised 1.5% higher over the last 30 days to the current level.
Based on the collective assessment of analysts, 'Revenue- Advertising' should arrive at $61.81 billion.
The estimate indicates a year-over-year change of +23.4%.
Analysts predict that the 'Revenue- Other' will reach $1.13 billion.
The estimate points to a change of +63.3% from the year-ago quarter.
The consensus estimate for 'Revenue- Family of Apps (FoA)' stands at $62.87 billion.
